name: 68467 · York, NE
findings: ZIP 68467 (York) has 72 nonprofit organizations. 29 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 24 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 68467 (York) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 68467 (York) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).
